verdict.rationale: Apify supports saved tasks that persist reusable input configurations (apify-docs-17, apify-docs-25) and an official MCP server for agents to discover and use Actors (apify-docs-10, apify-probe-3). Results come back as structured datasets exportable to JSON, CSV and other formats (apify-docs-32). However, these are generic building blocks; nothing in the evidence shows a preset tuned for research agents or citation-ready output. Missing for 10: a documented research-agent preset or template, citable output with source URLs or attribution fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
